## 6.1 Class FAU — Security Audit

[Read section 6.1 in the full text](/edi-stelsel/text/nl-cs-wsca#s-6-1)

### FAU\_GEN.1 — Audit Data Generation {#fau_gen-1}

- FAU\_GEN.1.1: The TSF shall generate an audit record of the following auditable events: a) TOE start-up and shutdown; b) All auditable events for the not specified level of audit; c) each signing operation, including the wallet user identifier; d) authentication failure; e) wallet instance and user lifecycle events (registration, suspension, deprovisioning); f) administrative and management operations ([FMT\_SMF.1](/edi-stelsel/requirements/nl-cs-wsca#fmt_smf-1)); and g) all self-test results ([FPT\_TST.1](/edi-stelsel/requirements/nl-cs-wsca#fpt_tst-1)) and secure initialization ([FPT\_INI.1](/edi-stelsel/requirements/nl-cs-wsca#fpt_ini-1)). h) failures listed in [FPT\_FLS.1](/edi-stelsel/requirements/nl-cs-wsca#fpt_fls-1) and [FPT\_RCV.4](/edi-stelsel/requirements/nl-cs-wsca#fpt_rcv-4). i) warning that audit trail is near full capacity ([FAU\_STG\_EXT.3](/edi-stelsel/requirements/nl-cs-wsca#fau_stg_ext-3)) j) failing checks related to transaction-bound authentication evidence ([FIA\_UAE\_EXT.1](/edi-stelsel/requirements/nl-cs-wsca#fia_uae_ext-1)) k) failure of establishing or detected attacks on a secure or trusted channel (FTP\_PRO.3/\* and FPT\_ITC.1/\*) l) failure of identification or authentication. m)detection of integrity or authenticity errors in stored user data. n) migration of user key bindings from one wallet user to another by the Wallet Provider o) \[assignment: other specifically defined auditable events\].
- FAU\_GEN.1.2: The TSF shall record within the audit data at least the following information: a) Date and time of the auditable event, type of event, subject identity (if applicable), and the outcome (success or failure) of the event; b) For each auditable event type, based on the auditable event definitions of the functional components included in the PP, PP-Module, functional package or ST, \[assignment: other audit relevant information\].

**Security functional requirement (SFR)** · obligation: **mandatory** · [PDF page 35](pathname:///files/edi-stelsel/2026-11-06/NL-CS-WSCA-RC1.1_-_for_publ.pdf#page=35)



### FAU\_GEN.2 — User identity association {#fau_gen-2}

- FAU\_GEN.2.1: For audit events resulting from actions of identified users, the TSF shall be able to associate each auditable event with the identity of the user that caused the event.

**Security functional requirement (SFR)** · obligation: **mandatory** · [PDF page 35](pathname:///files/edi-stelsel/2026-11-06/NL-CS-WSCA-RC1.1_-_for_publ.pdf#page=35)



### FAU\_SAR.1 — Audit review {#fau_sar-1}

- FAU\_SAR.1.1: The TSF shall provide Wallet Provider with the capability to read \[assignment: list of audit information\] from the audit data.
- FAU\_SAR.1.2: The TSF shall provide the audit data in a manner suitable for the user to interpret the information.

**Security functional requirement (SFR)** · obligation: **mandatory** · [PDF page 35](pathname:///files/edi-stelsel/2026-11-06/NL-CS-WSCA-RC1.1_-_for_publ.pdf#page=35)



### FAU\_STG\_EXT.1 — Protected Audit Event Storage {#fau_stg_ext-1}

- FAU\_STG\_EXT.1.1: The TSF shall be able to transmit the generated audit data to an external IT entity.
- FAU\_STG\_EXT.1.2: The TSF shall be able to store generated audit data on the TOE itself.
- FAU\_STG\_EXT.1.3: The TSF shall maintain a \[selection: log file, database, buffer, \[assignment: other local logging method\]\] of audit records in the event that an interruption of communication with the remote audit server occurs.
- FAU\_STG\_EXT.1.4: The TSF shall be able to store \[selection: persistent, non-persistent\] audit records locally with a minimum storage size of \[assignment: number of records and/or file/buffer size(s)\].
- FAU\_STG\_EXT.1.5: The TSF shall reject remote API requests from Wallet Instances when the local storage space for audit data is full.
- FAU\_STG\_EXT.1.6: The TSF shall ensure the authenticity and integrity of the audit data when stored on an external IT entity or the TOE itself with cryptographic means.

**Security functional requirement (SFR)** · obligation: **mandatory** · [PDF page 35](pathname:///files/edi-stelsel/2026-11-06/NL-CS-WSCA-RC1.1_-_for_publ.pdf#page=35)



### FAU\_STG\_EXT.2 — Counting Lost Audit Data {#fau_stg_ext-2}

- FAU\_STG\_EXT.2.1: The TSF shall provide information about the number of dropped audit records the case where the local storage has been filled and the TSF takes one of the actions defined in FAU\_STG\_EXT.1.5.

**Security functional requirement (SFR)** · obligation: **mandatory** · [PDF page 36](pathname:///files/edi-stelsel/2026-11-06/NL-CS-WSCA-RC1.1_-_for_publ.pdf#page=36)



### FAU\_STG\_EXT.3 — Notification in Case of Possible Audit Data Loss {#fau_stg_ext-3}

- FAU\_STG\_EXT.3.1: The TSF shall generate a warning to inform \[selection: Wallet Provider, Technical Administrator\] before the audit trail exceeds the local audit trail storage capacity.

**Security functional requirement (SFR)** · obligation: **mandatory** · [PDF page 36](pathname:///files/edi-stelsel/2026-11-06/NL-CS-WSCA-RC1.1_-_for_publ.pdf#page=36)

**Referenced by:** [FAU\_GEN.1](/edi-stelsel/requirements/nl-cs-wsca#fau_gen-1)

## 6.2 Class FCO — Communication

[Read section 6.2 in the full text](/edi-stelsel/text/nl-cs-wsca#s-6-2)

### FCO\_NRO.2 — Enforced proof of origin {#fco_nro-2}

- FCO\_NRO.2.1: The TSF shall enforce the generation of evidence of origin for transmitted API requests from the Wallet Instance handled by the TOE at all times.
- FCO\_NRO.2.2: The TSF shall be able to relate the Wallet Instance identifier of the originator of the information, and the transaction identifier, UTC timestamp of the information to which the evidence applies.
- FCO\_NRO.2.3: The TSF shall provide a capability to verify the evidence of origin of information to the Wallet Provider given the corresponding audit record is retained by the audit log server.

**Security functional requirement (SFR)** · obligation: **mandatory** · [PDF page 36](pathname:///files/edi-stelsel/2026-11-06/NL-CS-WSCA-RC1.1_-_for_publ.pdf#page=36)



### FCO\_NRR.2 — Enforced proof of receipt {#fco_nrr-2}

- FCO\_NRR.2.1: The TSF shall enforce the generation of evidence of receipt for received API requests from the Wallet Instance handled by the TOE at all times.
- FCO\_NRR.2.2: The TSF shall be able to relate the session identifier of the recipient of the information, and the Wallet Instance’s certificate, public key or thumbprint and the transaction identifier of the information to which the evidence applies.
- FCO\_NRR.2.3: The TSF shall provide a capability to verify the evidence of receipt of information to the Wallet Provider given the corresponding audit record is retained by the audit log server.

**Security functional requirement (SFR)** · obligation: **mandatory** · [PDF page 36](pathname:///files/edi-stelsel/2026-11-06/NL-CS-WSCA-RC1.1_-_for_publ.pdf#page=36)

## 6.4 Class FDP — User Data Protection

[Read section 6.4 in the full text](/edi-stelsel/text/nl-cs-wsca#s-6-4)

### FDP\_ACC.1/User\_Creation — Access Control Policy {#fdp_acc-1-user_creation}

- FDP\_ACC.1.1/User\_Creation: The TSF shall enforce the User Creation SFP on - Subject: Wallet Provider or Wallet Instance - Objects: Wallet User - Operations: Create new user The TOE creates a Wallet User with information provided by the subject.

**Security functional requirement (SFR)** · obligation: **mandatory** · [PDF page 38](pathname:///files/edi-stelsel/2026-11-06/NL-CS-WSCA-RC1.1_-_for_publ.pdf#page=38)



### FDP\_ACF.1/User\_Creation — Access control functions {#fdp_acf-1-user_creation}

- FDP\_ACF.1.1/User\_Creation: The TSF shall enforce the User Creation SFP to objects based on the following: whether the subject is a Wallet Provider or Wallet Instance authorised to create a new Wallet User.
- FDP\_ACF.1.2/User\_Creation: The TSF shall enforce the following rules to determine if an operation among controlled subjects and controlled objects is allowed: only a Wallet Provider or Wallet Instance who has been authorised for creation of new users can carry out the operation.
- FDP\_ACF.1.3/User\_Creation: The TSF shall explicitly authorize access of subjects to objects based on the following additional rules: none.
- FDP\_ACF.1.4/User\_Creation: The TSF shall explicitly deny access of subjects to objects based on the following additional rules: \[assignment: rules, based on security attributes, that explicitly deny access of subjects to objects\].

**Security functional requirement (SFR)** · obligation: **mandatory** · [PDF page 38](pathname:///files/edi-stelsel/2026-11-06/NL-CS-WSCA-RC1.1_-_for_publ.pdf#page=38)



### FDP\_ACC.1/Key\_Management — Access Control Policy {#fdp_acc-1-key_management}

- FDP\_ACC.1.1/Key\_Creation: The TSF shall enforce the Key Creation SFP on - Subject: Wallet Instance - Objects: Asymmetric key pairs or symmetric keys - Operations: Create or delete new key or key pair Wallet Instances instructs the TOE to request the WSCD to generate/delete new keys/key pairs and assigns it to a Wallet User.

**Security functional requirement (SFR)** · obligation: **mandatory** · [PDF page 39](pathname:///files/edi-stelsel/2026-11-06/NL-CS-WSCA-RC1.1_-_for_publ.pdf#page=39)



### FDP\_ACF.1/Key\_Management — Access control functions {#fdp_acf-1-key_management}

- FDP\_ACF.1.1/Key\_Creation: The TSF shall enforce the Key Creation SFP to objects based on the following: the wallet instance is authorised to create, delete a symmetric key or asymmetric key pairs for a Wallet User.
- FDP\_ACF.1.2/Key\_Creation: The TSF shall enforce the following rules to determine if an operation among controlled subjects and controlled objects is allowed: the wallet instance requesting the creation of the key or key pair is authorised to carry out the operation.
- FDP\_ACF.1.3/Key\_Creation: The TSF shall explicitly authorize access of subjects to objects based on the following additional rules: none.
- FDP\_ACF.1.4/Key\_Creation: The TSF shall explicitly deny access of subjects to objects based on the following additional rules: \[assignment: rules, based on security attributes, that explicitly deny access of subjects to objects\].

**Security functional requirement (SFR)** · obligation: **mandatory** · [PDF page 39](pathname:///files/edi-stelsel/2026-11-06/NL-CS-WSCA-RC1.1_-_for_publ.pdf#page=39)



### FDP\_ACC.1/Operation — Access Control Policy {#fdp_acc-1-operation}

- FDP\_ACC.1.1/Operation: The TSF shall enforce the Operation SFP on - Subject: Wallet User - Objects: Wallet User user-bound assets (including keys or key pairs) - Operations: (Per-key-authorized) Operations with Wallet User user-bound assets The TOE instructs the WSCD to carry out operations on and with the Wallet Users assets only where it corresponds to an assets within the WSCD-HSM that is bound to the identified Wallet User using per-key-authorization data provided by the wallet instance. - Subject: Wallet User - Objects: Wallet User user-bound assets (including keys or key pairs) - Operations: PIN reset The TOE instructs the WSCD to carry out PIN reset when the correct PUK was provided. - Subject: Wallet User - Objects: Wallet User user bound assets - Operation: Wallet User can clear or delete the Wallet User bound assets or migrate them to a different Wallet Instance. (This does not include the WSCD-stored plaintext private keys, only their reference, keyblobs and management).

**Security functional requirement (SFR)** · obligation: **mandatory** · [PDF page 39](pathname:///files/edi-stelsel/2026-11-06/NL-CS-WSCA-RC1.1_-_for_publ.pdf#page=39)



### FDP\_ACF.1/Operation — Access control functions {#fdp_acf-1-operation}

- FDP\_ACF.1.1/Operation: The TSF shall enforce the Operation SFP to objects based on the following: whether the subject is a Wallet User or Wallet Provider authorised to carry out the operation or resets the PIN using the correct PUK.
- FDP\_ACF.1.2/Operation: The TSF shall enforce the following rules to determine if an operation among controlled subjects and controlled objects is allowed: • only an authorized Wallet User is allowed to carry out operations using the keys or key pairs • a Wallet User is only allowed to carry out operations using their user-bound keys. • the authentication evidence is valid and bound to the current transaction. • the identifier of the Wallet User does match the user bound to the key or key pair • the Wallet User is active. • the integrity of all operation related assets was verified. • the Wallet Provider carrying out operations is authorized and authenticated.
- FDP\_ACF.1.3/Operation: The TSF shall explicitly authorize access of subjects to objects based on the following additional rules: none.
- FDP\_ACF.1.4/Operation: The TSF shall explicitly deny access of subjects to objects based on the following additional rules: any direct key access or key export requests for keys residing in the WSCD shall be denied \[assignment: additional rules, based on security attributes, that explicitly deny access of subjects to objects\].

**Security functional requirement (SFR)** · obligation: **mandatory** · [PDF page 39](pathname:///files/edi-stelsel/2026-11-06/NL-CS-WSCA-RC1.1_-_for_publ.pdf#page=39)



### FDP\_RIP.2 — Full residual information protection {#fdp_rip-2}

- FDP\_RIP.2.1: The TSF shall ensure that any previous information content of a resource is made unavailable upon the deallocation of the resource from all objects.

**Security functional requirement (SFR)** · obligation: **mandatory** · [PDF page 40](pathname:///files/edi-stelsel/2026-11-06/NL-CS-WSCA-RC1.1_-_for_publ.pdf#page=40)



### FDP\_SDI.1 — Stored data integrity monitoring {#fdp_sdi-1}

- FDP\_SDI.1.1: The TSF shall monitor user data stored in containers controlled by the TSF or in its operative environment for integrity or authenticity errors on all objects, based on the following attributes: the integrity and authenticity check value bound to each stored object.

**Security functional requirement (SFR)** · obligation: **mandatory** · [PDF page 40](pathname:///files/edi-stelsel/2026-11-06/NL-CS-WSCA-RC1.1_-_for_publ.pdf#page=40)

**Referenced by:** [FIA\_USB.1/Wallet](/edi-stelsel/requirements/nl-cs-wsca#fia_usb-1-wallet)

### FDP\_SDC.1 — Stored data confidentiality {#fdp_sdc-1}

- FDP\_SDC.1.1: The TSF shall ensure the confidentiality of the following user data: session keys and WSCA-stored private keys while it is stored in the persistent memory (including the external database).

**Security functional requirement (SFR)** · obligation: **mandatory** · [PDF page 40](pathname:///files/edi-stelsel/2026-11-06/NL-CS-WSCA-RC1.1_-_for_publ.pdf#page=40)

### FIA\_ATD.1/Wallet — User attribute definition {#fia_atd-1-wallet}

- FIA\_ATD.1.1/Wallet: The TSF shall maintain the following list of security attributes belonging to individual users: a) wallet instance and wallet user identifier b) the registered Wallet Instance authentication credential, used both for authentication of the communication session and for verification of signatures over User Authentication Evidence c) the Authentication Reference Data against which the knowledge- and possession-based factor of the User Authentication Evidence is verified d) the binding records associating the wallet user with its wrapped key blobs, its attested key pairs and, where the WIA device-binding key pair is managed by the WSCA/WSCD, that key pair e) the per-key authorisation data associated with the wallet user for access to the WSCD-HSM, for the duration of the operation for which it was provided f) the authentication failure counter g) the wallet user status (active / suspended / deprovisioned) h) the integrity check value and version counter bound to the stored attributes of the wallet user i) \[assignment: additional user security attributes\].

**Security functional requirement (SFR)** · obligation: **mandatory** · [PDF page 41](pathname:///files/edi-stelsel/2026-11-06/NL-CS-WSCA-RC1.1_-_for_publ.pdf#page=41)

**Referenced by:** [FIA\_USB.1/Wallet](/edi-stelsel/requirements/nl-cs-wsca#fia_usb-1-wallet)

### FIA\_ATD.1/Provider — User attribute definition {#fia_atd-1-provider}

- FIA\_ATD.1.1/Provider: The TSF shall maintain the following list of security attributes belonging to individual users: a) the Wallet Provider identifier b) the Wallet Provider authentication reference data c) \[assignment: additional provider security attributes\]

**Security functional requirement (SFR)** · obligation: **mandatory** · [PDF page 41](pathname:///files/edi-stelsel/2026-11-06/NL-CS-WSCA-RC1.1_-_for_publ.pdf#page=41)



### FIA\_USB.1/Wallet — User-subject binding {#fia_usb-1-wallet}

- FIA\_USB.1.1/Wallet: The TSF shall associate the following user security attributes with subjects acting on the behalf of that user: • the wallet instance and wallet user identifier • the wallet instance and wallet user authentication data • the wallet user status defined in [FIA\_ATD.1/Wallet](/edi-stelsel/requirements/nl-cs-wsca#fia_atd-1-wallet) • the binding records in FIA\_ATD.1.1/Wallet • the per-key authorisation data in FIA\_ATD.1.1/Wallet • \[assignment: list of user security attributes\]
- FIA\_USB.1.2/Wallet: The TSF shall enforce the following rules on the initial association of user security attributes with subjects acting on the behalf of users: • the wallet instance identifier and the registered Wallet Instance authentication credential shall be associated only after successful identification in accordance with [FIA\_UID.2](/edi-stelsel/requirements/nl-cs-wsca#fia_uid-2) and successful establishment of a trusted channel in accordance with [FTP\_PRO.2/Wallet](/edi-stelsel/requirements/nl-cs-wsca#ftp_pro-2-wallet) • the wallet user identifier, the wallet user status, the binding records and the per-key authorisation data shall be associated only after successful verification of authentication evidence in accordance with [FIA\_UAE\_EXT.1](/edi-stelsel/requirements/nl-cs-wsca#fia_uae_ext-1) against the Authentication Reference Data registered for that wallet user • only the attributes of the wallet user for whom the identified wallet instance is registered shall be associated • only the binding records and per-key authorisation data for the keys bound to that wallet user shall be associated • no attribute shall be associated where the wallet user status is other than active • no attribute shall be associated where an integrity or authenticity error has been detected in accordance with [FDP\_SDI.1](/edi-stelsel/requirements/nl-cs-wsca#fdp_sdi-1) on the stored attributes concerned • \[assignment: rules for the initial association of attributes\]
- FIA\_USB.1.3/Wallet: The TSF shall enforce the following rules governing changes to the user security attributes associated with subjects acting on the behalf of users: • the attributes associated under FIA\_USB.1.2/Wallet • shall remain associated only for the operation for which the authentication evidence was verified, and shall be dissociated on completion of that operation or on expiry of the validity window of that evidence, whichever occurs first; • no associated attribute shall be modified at the request of the subject; • the authentication failure counter may change as a result of FIA\_AFL.1; • a change of the wallet user status to suspended or deprovisioned shall take effect immediately and shall cause dissociation of all attributes associated with subjects acting on behalf of that wallet user; • a change to the binding records or to the per-key authorisation data shall take effect on the next association only. • \[assignment: rules for the changing of attributes\].

**Security functional requirement (SFR)** · obligation: **mandatory** · [PDF page 41](pathname:///files/edi-stelsel/2026-11-06/NL-CS-WSCA-RC1.1_-_for_publ.pdf#page=41)

**Referenced by:** [FMT\_MSA.1/User\_Creation](/edi-stelsel/requirements/nl-cs-wsca#fmt_msa-1-user_creation), [FMT\_MSA.1/Key\_Management](/edi-stelsel/requirements/nl-cs-wsca#fmt_msa-1-key_management), [FMT\_MSA.1/Operation](/edi-stelsel/requirements/nl-cs-wsca#fmt_msa-1-operation), [FMT\_MSA.2](/edi-stelsel/requirements/nl-cs-wsca#fmt_msa-2)

### FIA\_USB.1/Provider — User-subject binding {#fia_usb-1-provider}

- FIA\_USB.1.1/Provider: The TSF shall associate the following user security attributes with subjects acting on the behalf of that user: • the wallet provider identifier • the wallet provider authentication data • \[assignment: list of user security attributes\]
- FIA\_USB.1.2/Provider: The TSF shall enforce the following rules on the initial association of user security attributes with subjects acting on the behalf of users: • attributes shall be associated only after successful identification in accordance with [FIA\_UID.2](/edi-stelsel/requirements/nl-cs-wsca#fia_uid-2) and successful establishment of a trusted channel in accordance with [FTP\_PRO.2/Provider](/edi-stelsel/requirements/nl-cs-wsca#ftp_pro-2-provider). • only the attributes of the Wallet Provider identified by the presented credential shall be associated; • only the role and the management functions for which that Wallet Provider is authorised shall be associated.
- FIA\_USB.1.3/Provider: The TSF shall enforce the following rules governing changes to the user security attributes associated with subjects acting on the behalf of users: • no associated attribute shall change for the duration of the association; • revocation or modification of the Wallet Provider authentication reference data shall cause dissociation of all attributes associated with subjects acting on its behalf; • a change to the role or to the permitted management functions shall take effect on the next association only

**Security functional requirement (SFR)** · obligation: **mandatory** · [PDF page 42](pathname:///files/edi-stelsel/2026-11-06/NL-CS-WSCA-RC1.1_-_for_publ.pdf#page=42)

**Referenced by:** [FMT\_MSA.2](/edi-stelsel/requirements/nl-cs-wsca#fmt_msa-2)

### FIA\_UAU.2 — User authentication before any action {#fia_uau-2}

- FIA\_UAU.2.1: The TSF shall require each user to be successfully authenticated before allowing any other TSF mediated actions on behalf of that user.

**Security functional requirement (SFR)** · obligation: **mandatory** · [PDF page 43](pathname:///files/edi-stelsel/2026-11-06/NL-CS-WSCA-RC1.1_-_for_publ.pdf#page=43)



### FIA\_UAU.6 — Re-authenticating {#fia_uau-6}

- FIA\_UAU.6.1: The TSF shall re-authenticate the user under the conditions before each signing request and for each credential management operation.

**Security functional requirement (SFR)** · obligation: **mandatory** · [PDF page 43](pathname:///files/edi-stelsel/2026-11-06/NL-CS-WSCA-RC1.1_-_for_publ.pdf#page=43)



### FIA\_UID.2 — User identification before any action {#fia_uid-2}

- FIA\_UID.2.1: The TSF shall require each user to be successfully identified before allowing any TSF-mediated actions on behalf of that user.

**Security functional requirement (SFR)** · obligation: **mandatory** · [PDF page 43](pathname:///files/edi-stelsel/2026-11-06/NL-CS-WSCA-RC1.1_-_for_publ.pdf#page=43)

**Referenced by:** [FIA\_USB.1/Wallet](/edi-stelsel/requirements/nl-cs-wsca#fia_usb-1-wallet), [FIA\_USB.1/Provider](/edi-stelsel/requirements/nl-cs-wsca#fia_usb-1-provider)

### FIA\_UAE\_EXT.1 — Transaction-bound authentication evidence {#fia_uae_ext-1}

- FIA\_UAE\_EXT.1.1: The TSF shall generate, for each request to perform an operation in \[assignment: list of operations requiring authentication evidence\], a challenge with a minimum of 128 bits of entropy obtained from a random bit generation function meeting [FCS\_RBG.1](/edi-stelsel/requirements/nl-cs-wsca#fcs_rbg-1).
- FIA\_UAE\_EXT.1.2: The TSF shall construct, for each challenge, a transaction context comprising the challenge, the identity of the user, the requested operation, and the wallet user identifier and \[assignment: other transaction attributes\] and shall associate that transaction context with the communication session on which the request was received.
- FIA\_UAE\_EXT.1.3: The TSF shall require that authentication evidence cryptographically bound to the transaction context of the requested operation be presented before the TSF performs any operation in operations defined in FIA\_UAE\_EXT.1.1.
- FIA\_UAE\_EXT.1.4: The TSF shall verify presented authentication evidence against the authentication reference data associated with the identified user and shall verify that the evidence demonstrates that each authentication factor in a) the possession-based factor of the wallet user and b) the knowledge-based factor derived from the PIN was verified.
- FIA\_UAE\_EXT.1.5: The TSF shall verify that presented authentication evidence was received no more than \[assignment: validity period\] after the corresponding challenge was issued.
- FIA\_UAE\_EXT.1.6: The TSF shall deny the requested operation if any verification required by FIA\_UAE\_EXT.1.3, FIA\_UAE\_EXT.1.4 or FIA\_UAE\_EXT.1.5 fails.

**Security functional requirement (SFR)** · obligation: **mandatory** · [PDF page 43](pathname:///files/edi-stelsel/2026-11-06/NL-CS-WSCA-RC1.1_-_for_publ.pdf#page=43)

**Referenced by:** [FAU\_GEN.1](/edi-stelsel/requirements/nl-cs-wsca#fau_gen-1), [FIA\_AFL.1/Wallet](/edi-stelsel/requirements/nl-cs-wsca#fia_afl-1-wallet), [FIA\_USB.1/Wallet](/edi-stelsel/requirements/nl-cs-wsca#fia_usb-1-wallet)

### FIA\_UAE\_EXT.2 — Single-use enforcement for authentication evidence {#fia_uae_ext-2}

- FIA\_UAE\_EXT.2.1: The TSF shall maintain a nonce registry covering all transaction identifiers issued and all evidence received within the validity window defined in FIA\_UAE\_EXT.1.5.
- FIA\_UAE\_EXT.2.2: The TSF shall deny the requested operation if the presented authentication evidence refers to a challenge that was not issued by the TSF, that has already been used in successful verification, or whose validity period has expired.

**Security functional requirement (SFR)** · obligation: **mandatory** · [PDF page 43](pathname:///files/edi-stelsel/2026-11-06/NL-CS-WSCA-RC1.1_-_for_publ.pdf#page=43)



## 6.6 Class FMT — Security Management

[Read section 6.6 in the full text](/edi-stelsel/text/nl-cs-wsca#s-6-6)

### FMT\_SMR.1 — Security roles {#fmt_smr-1}

- FMT\_SMR.1.1: The TSF shall maintain the roles • Wallet User • Wallet Instance • Wallet Provider • \[assignment: additional authorized identified roles\].
- FMT\_SMR.1.2: The TSF shall be able to associate users with roles.

**Security functional requirement (SFR)** · obligation: **mandatory** · [PDF page 43](pathname:///files/edi-stelsel/2026-11-06/NL-CS-WSCA-RC1.1_-_for_publ.pdf#page=43)



### FMT\_SMF.1 — Specification of Management Functions {#fmt_smf-1}

- FMT\_SMF.1.1: The TSF shall be capable of performing the following management functions: • For the Wallet Provider: o TOE unique self-identification of version and configuration o TOE maintenance o Audit data review o Factory Reset o Deletion or reset of user authentication data o \[assignment: list of management functions to be provided by the TSF\]. • For the Wallet User: o Modifying user authentication data o PIN reset using PUK o Wallet Instance Migration

**Security functional requirement (SFR)** · obligation: **mandatory** · [PDF page 44](pathname:///files/edi-stelsel/2026-11-06/NL-CS-WSCA-RC1.1_-_for_publ.pdf#page=44)

**Referenced by:** [FAU\_GEN.1](/edi-stelsel/requirements/nl-cs-wsca#fau_gen-1)

### FMT\_MSA.1/User\_Creation — Management of security attributes {#fmt_msa-1-user_creation}

- FMT\_MSA.1.1/User\_Creation: The TSF shall enforce the User Creation SFP to restrict the ability to modify the security attributes that are Wallet User related as defined in [FIA\_USB.1/Wallet](/edi-stelsel/requirements/nl-cs-wsca#fia_usb-1-wallet) to the Wallet Provider or Wallet Instance.

**Security functional requirement (SFR)** · obligation: **mandatory** · [PDF page 44](pathname:///files/edi-stelsel/2026-11-06/NL-CS-WSCA-RC1.1_-_for_publ.pdf#page=44)



### FMT\_MSA.3/User\_Creation — Static attribute initialization {#fmt_msa-3-user_creation}

- FMT\_MSA.3.1/User\_Creation: The TSF shall enforce the User Creation SFP to provide restrictive default values for security attributes that are used to enforce the SFP.
- FMT\_MSA.3.2/User\_Creation: The TSF shall allow the Wallet Provider or Wallet Instance to specify alternative initial values to override the default values when an object or information is created.

**Security functional requirement (SFR)** · obligation: **mandatory** · [PDF page 44](pathname:///files/edi-stelsel/2026-11-06/NL-CS-WSCA-RC1.1_-_for_publ.pdf#page=44)



### FMT\_MSA.1/Key\_Management — Management of security attributes {#fmt_msa-1-key_management}

- FMT\_MSA.1.1/Key\_Management: The TSF shall enforce the Key Management SFP to restrict the ability to modify, delete the security attributes Wallet User keys related attributes as defined in [FIA\_USB.1/Wallet](/edi-stelsel/requirements/nl-cs-wsca#fia_usb-1-wallet) to the Wallet Instance or Wallet Provider (deletion only).

**Security functional requirement (SFR)** · obligation: **mandatory** · [PDF page 44](pathname:///files/edi-stelsel/2026-11-06/NL-CS-WSCA-RC1.1_-_for_publ.pdf#page=44)



### FMT\_MSA.3/Key\_Management — Static attribute initialization {#fmt_msa-3-key_management}

- FMT\_MSA.3.1/Key\_Management: The TSF shall enforce the Key Management SFP to provide restrictive default values for security attributes that are used to enforce the SFP.
- FMT\_MSA.3.2/Key\_Management: The TSF shall allow the Wallet Instance to specify alternative initial values to override the default values when an object or information is created.

**Security functional requirement (SFR)** · obligation: **mandatory** · [PDF page 44](pathname:///files/edi-stelsel/2026-11-06/NL-CS-WSCA-RC1.1_-_for_publ.pdf#page=44)



### FMT\_MSA.1/Operation — Management of security attributes {#fmt_msa-1-operation}

- FMT\_MSA.1.1/Operation: The TSF shall enforce the Operation SFP to restrict the ability to query the security attributes Wallet User keys related attributes as defined in [FIA\_USB.1/Wallet](/edi-stelsel/requirements/nl-cs-wsca#fia_usb-1-wallet) to the Wallet User.

**Security functional requirement (SFR)** · obligation: **mandatory** · [PDF page 44](pathname:///files/edi-stelsel/2026-11-06/NL-CS-WSCA-RC1.1_-_for_publ.pdf#page=44)



### FMT\_MSA.2 — Secure security attributes {#fmt_msa-2}

- FMT\_MSA.2.1: The TSF shall ensure that only secure values are accepted for attributes defined in [FIA\_USB.1/Wallet](/edi-stelsel/requirements/nl-cs-wsca#fia_usb-1-wallet) and [FIA\_USB.1/Provider](/edi-stelsel/requirements/nl-cs-wsca#fia_usb-1-provider).

**Security functional requirement (SFR)** · obligation: **mandatory** · [PDF page 44](pathname:///files/edi-stelsel/2026-11-06/NL-CS-WSCA-RC1.1_-_for_publ.pdf#page=44)



### FMT\_MTD.1/Provider — Management of TSF data {#fmt_mtd-1-provider}

- FMT\_MTD.1.1/Provider: The TSF shall restrict the ability to modify the Wallet Provider and WSCD authentication data to Wallet Provider.

**Security functional requirement (SFR)** · obligation: **mandatory** · [PDF page 44](pathname:///files/edi-stelsel/2026-11-06/NL-CS-WSCA-RC1.1_-_for_publ.pdf#page=44)



### FMT\_MTD.1/User — Management of TSF data {#fmt_mtd-1-user}

- FMT\_MTD.1.1/Provider: The TSF shall restrict the ability to modify the their Wallet User authentication data to an authenticated Wallet User. However, delete and clear are available for the Wallet Provider.

**Security functional requirement (SFR)** · obligation: **mandatory** · [PDF page 45](pathname:///files/edi-stelsel/2026-11-06/NL-CS-WSCA-RC1.1_-_for_publ.pdf#page=45)



### FMT\_MTD.1/Instance — Management of TSF data {#fmt_mtd-1-instance}

- FMT\_MTD.1.1/Provider: The TSF shall restrict the ability to modify the their Wallet Instance authentication data to an authenticated Wallet Instance. However, delete and clear are available for the Wallet Provider.

**Security functional requirement (SFR)** · obligation: **mandatory** · [PDF page 45](pathname:///files/edi-stelsel/2026-11-06/NL-CS-WSCA-RC1.1_-_for_publ.pdf#page=45)



## 6.7 Class FPT — Protection of the TSF

[Read section 6.7 in the full text](/edi-stelsel/text/nl-cs-wsca#s-6-7)

### FPT\_FLS.1 — Failure with preservation of secure state {#fpt_fls-1}

- FPT\_FLS.1.1: The TSF shall preserve a secure state when the following types of failures occur: WSCD-HSM connection failure; credential store integrity check failure; audit log unavailability; \[assignment: additional types of failures in the TSF\].

**Security functional requirement (SFR)** · obligation: **mandatory** · [PDF page 45](pathname:///files/edi-stelsel/2026-11-06/NL-CS-WSCA-RC1.1_-_for_publ.pdf#page=45)

**Referenced by:** [FAU\_GEN.1](/edi-stelsel/requirements/nl-cs-wsca#fau_gen-1)

### FPT\_ITC.1 — Inter-TSF confidentiality during transmission {#fpt_itc-1}

- FPT\_ITC.1.1: The TSF shall protect all TSF data transmitted from the TSF to another trusted IT product the WSCD-HSM from unauthorized disclosure during transmission.

**Security functional requirement (SFR)** · obligation: **mandatory** · [PDF page 45](pathname:///files/edi-stelsel/2026-11-06/NL-CS-WSCA-RC1.1_-_for_publ.pdf#page=45)



### FPT\_ITI.1 — Inter-TSF detection of modification {#fpt_iti-1}

- FPT\_ITI.1.1: The TSF shall provide the capability to detect modification of all TSF data during transmission between the TSF and another trusted IT product the WSCD-HSM within the following metric: \[assignment: a defined modification metric\].
- FPT\_ITI.1.2: The TSF shall provide the capability to verify the integrity of all TSF data transmitted between the TSF and another trusted IT product the WSCD-HSM and perform \[assignment: action to be taken\] if modifications are detected.

**Security functional requirement (SFR)** · obligation: **mandatory** · [PDF page 45](pathname:///files/edi-stelsel/2026-11-06/NL-CS-WSCA-RC1.1_-_for_publ.pdf#page=45)



### FPT\_RCV.4 — Function recovery {#fpt_rcv-4}

- FPT\_RCV.4.1: The TSF shall ensure that all credential management and HSM operations \[assignment: additional list of functions and failure scenarios\] have the property that the function either completes successfully, or for the indicated failure scenarios, recovers to a consistent and secure state.

**Security functional requirement (SFR)** · obligation: **mandatory** · [PDF page 45](pathname:///files/edi-stelsel/2026-11-06/NL-CS-WSCA-RC1.1_-_for_publ.pdf#page=45)

**Referenced by:** [FAU\_GEN.1](/edi-stelsel/requirements/nl-cs-wsca#fau_gen-1)

### FPT\_TST.1 — TSF self-testing {#fpt_tst-1}

- FPT\_TST.1.1: The TSF shall run a suite of the following self-tests during initial start-up, periodically during normal operation, at the request of the authorized user to demonstrate the correct operation of correct operation of cryptographic libraries if applicable; WSCD-HSM connectivity and authentication; credential store integrity; audit log availability; and correct operation of the transaction identifier registry \[assignment: other parts of the TSF\]: \[assignment: list of self-tests run by the TSF\].
- FPT\_TST.1.2: The TSF shall provide authorized users with the capability to verify the integrity of \[selection: \[assignment: parts of TSF data\], TSF data\].
- FPT\_TST.1.3: The TSF shall provide authorized users with the capability to verify the integrity of \[selection: \[assignment: parts of TSF\], TSF\].

**Security functional requirement (SFR)** · obligation: **mandatory** · [PDF page 45](pathname:///files/edi-stelsel/2026-11-06/NL-CS-WSCA-RC1.1_-_for_publ.pdf#page=45)

**Referenced by:** [FAU\_GEN.1](/edi-stelsel/requirements/nl-cs-wsca#fau_gen-1)

### FPT\_INI.1 — TSF initalization {#fpt_ini-1}

- FPT\_INI.1.1: The TOE shall provide an initialization function which is self-protected for integrity and authenticity.
- FPT\_INI.1.2: The TOE initialization function shall ensure that certain properties hold on certain elements immediately before establishing the TSF in a secure initial state, as specified in \[table: ID 1 – Properties: integrity – Elements: Software binary, configuration; ID 2 – Properties: \[assignment: property, for instance authenticity, integrity, correct version\] – Elements: \[assignment: list of TSF/user firmware, software or data\]\]
- FPT\_INI.1.3: The TOE initialization function shall detect and respond to errors and failures during initialization such that the TOE: is halted.
- FPT\_INI.1.4: The TOE initialization function shall only interact with the TSF in a restrictive way that allows for the verification of the properties and elements stated in FPT\_INI.1.2 during initialization.

**Security functional requirement (SFR)** · obligation: **mandatory** · [PDF page 46](pathname:///files/edi-stelsel/2026-11-06/NL-CS-WSCA-RC1.1_-_for_publ.pdf#page=46)

**Referenced by:** [FAU\_GEN.1](/edi-stelsel/requirements/nl-cs-wsca#fau_gen-1)

- FTP\_ITC.1.1/WSCA-HSM: The TSF shall provide a communication channel between itself and another trusted IT product the WSCD-HSM that is logically distinct from other communication channels and provides assured identification of its end points and protection of the channel data from modification or disclosure.
